Title: PSMHardening.ps1 has run and its log has no errors
Evidence: latest log: /fake/PSM/Hardening/PSMHardening.log (02/01/2026 00:00:00) | error lines: Step 3 failed: access denied
Remediation: Run <PSM>\Hardening\PSMHardening.ps1 as Administrator (execution policy RemoteSigned, read-only flag removed). Then review the log.
FindText: check the log for errors || Hardening || Hardening

Title: Hardening re-applied after the last PSM upgrade
Evidence: newest hardening log 2026-02-01 00:00:00Z vs newest binary 2026-06-01 00:00:00Z (CAPSM.exe)
Remediation: After an upgrade, re-run the NEW PSMHardening.ps1 and PSMConfigureAppLocker.ps1. Do not use the backed-up copies.
FindText: reapply after upgrades || don't use the backed-up

Title: RDP-Tcp MinEncryptionLevel = 3 (High)
Remediation: Re-run PSMHardening.ps1, or set MinEncryptionLevel=3 on the RDP-Tcp listener.

Title: RDP-Tcp SecurityLayer changed by hardening (review the value)
Remediation: The docs say the script changes SecurityLayer but the excerpt did not give the target value. Compare against the PSM hardening page for your version.

Title: SMB1 server disabled
Remediation: Set-SmbServerConfiguration -EnableSMB1Protocol $false, or re-run hardening.
FindText: Disables the SMB1 Server || Disables the SMB1 Server

Title: SMB1 client disabled (mrxsmb10 disabled, removed from LanmanWorkstation dependencies)
Remediation: Re-run hardening, or disable mrxsmb10 (Start=4) and remove MRxSmb10 from LanmanWorkstation DependOnService.

Title: SSL 2.0/3.0 and TLS 1.0/1.1 disabled (Enabled=0, DisabledByDefault=1)
Evidence: SSL 2.0/Server: Enabled=<unset> DisabledByDefault=<unset>; SSL 2.0/Client: Enabled=<unset> DisabledByDefault=<unset>; SSL 3.0/Server: Enabled=<unset> DisabledByDefault=<unset>; SSL 3.0/Client: Enabled=<unset> DisabledByDefault=<unset>; TLS 1.0/Server: Enabled=<unset> DisabledByDefault=<unset>; TLS 1.0/Client: Enabled=<unset> DisabledByDefault=<unset>; TLS 1.1/Server: Enabled=<unset> DisabledByDefault=<unset>; TLS 1.1/Client: Enabled=<unset> DisabledByDefault=<unset>
Remediation: Run the TLS hardening step. If an older connector needs TLS 1.0/1.1, the docs require a manual registry change afterwards. Document that exception.
FindText: Disables SSL/TLS versions earlier than TLS 1.2 || earlier than TLS 1.2

Title: Remote Desktop Users group cleared (optional: ClearRemoteDesktopUsers, default No)
Evidence: Optional step (off by default) not applied | 'Remote Desktop Users' members: CORP\helpdesk
Remediation: The group should contain only non-admin maintenance users. Review the members listed in the evidence.
FindText: ClearRemoteDesktopUsers (Default: No) || ClearRemoteDesktopUsers || If you use ActiveX it is recommended to leave the ClearRemoteDesktopUsers parameter set to "No"

Title: AppLocker enforced (AppIDSvc running and effective EXE rules enforced)
Remediation: Run <PSM>\Hardening\PSMConfigureAppLocker.ps1. Add custom connector executables to PSMConfigureAppLocker.xml first.
FindText: PSMConfigureAppLocker || All AppLocker rules are defined in the PSMConfigureAppLocker.xml file || AppLocker

Title: PSMConfigureAppLocker.xml present (review custom rules after upgrade)
Remediation: Restore the AppLocker files from the PSM installation package.

Title: PSMShadowUsers local group exists (created and used by hardening ACLs)
Remediation: Re-run PSM installation or hardening.

Title: Folder ACLs for PSMConnect / PSMAdminConnect / PSMShadowUsers on the PSM folder
Remediation: If the script warned about PVWA detection, fix the permissions by hand for PSMConnect and PSMAdminConnect on C:\CyberArk and C:\InetPub.
FindText: PSMAdminConnect || modify the permissions manually for PSMConnect and PSMAdminConnect

Title: Outbound TCP 80/443 to 168.63.129.16 blocked (Windows Firewall rule)
Remediation: Re-run PSM hardening. Note: only the Standard page was confirmed. ISPSS applicability was not verified.

Title: Xbox-related services disabled (if present)
Remediation: Re-run PSM hardening, or set these services to Disabled. The service names are Windows names, not taken from the doc.

Title: Web application support setting reviewed (SupportWebApplications, default Yes)
Evidence: setting not found in hardening files (default applies)
Remediation: Disable it if PSM is not used for web applications. Values must be approved by your security team.

Title: PSMShadowUsers has 'Allow log on locally'
Remediation: Enable the out-of-domain step in PSMHardening (default No), or import the PSM INF via gpedit.msc and add the right.
FindText: Add the PSMShadowUsers group to the Allow log on locally list || PSMShadowUsers

Title: PSMConnect and PSMAdminConnect have 'Allow log on through Remote Desktop Services'
Remediation: Grant the right only to PSMConnect, PSMAdminConnect and named maintenance users. Review any other principals listed in the evidence.
FindText: this setting must only be allowed for the PSMConnect and PSMAdminConnect users

Title: Idle RDS session time limit set
Remediation: Enable the out-of-domain step, or set 'Set time limit for active but idle RDS sessions'. The Standard doc describes a 2-day value.
FindText: Sets a time limit for active but idle RDS sessions || idle

Title: Advanced audit policy applied (INF / Advanced Audit CSV import)
Remediation: Import the Advanced Audit CSV into System Audit Policies (Local GPO), or enable the out-of-domain script step.

Title: PSM INF security template imported (Local Security Policy)
Remediation: Run gpedit.msc > Computer Configuration > Windows Settings > Security Settings, right-click > Import Policy, and select the PSM INF. Windows keeps no reliable marker of an INF import, so verify by hand with secedit /analyze against the INF.
FindText: Import Policy || Imports an INF file to the local machine

Title: RDS policy: automatic reconnection disabled
Remediation: In-domain: comes from the CyberArk PSM GPO. Out-of-domain: set it by hand in gpedit.msc (Remote Desktop Session Host > Connections).
FindText: This part of the hardening procedure is not included in the hardening script and must be performed manually

Title: RDS policy: client connection encryption level High
Remediation: Set 'Set client connection encryption level' = High via GPO, or in local policy when out of domain.

Title: RDS redirection (clipboard / drive / printer) disabled if not used
Evidence: Optional step (off by default) not applied | HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows NT\Terminal Services\fDisableClip not present | HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows NT\Terminal Services\fDisableCdm not present | HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows NT\Terminal Services\fDisableCpm not present
Remediation: Conditional step: disable only the redirections your business does not use.
FindText: If Clipboard/Drive/Printer redirection are not being used, disable them

Title: CyberArk PSM hardening GPO applied and winning
Evidence: applied computer GPOs: Default Domain Policy; matched: <none>
Remediation: Import the GPO in GPMC, link it to the PSM servers OU, run gpupdate /force, then verify with gpresult /h or rsop.msc.

Title: Privilege Cloud Unified Hardening GPO (or PSM-only GPO) applied
Remediation: Link the latest Unified Hardening GPO (check the marketplace version; the docs cite v2.4.0 and v2.5.0). Legacy CPM/PSM GPOs no longer apply from v13.0.
FindText: Active Directory domain ('In Domain') || In Domain || Unified Hardening GPO

Title: Connector computer is in a dedicated OU
Remediation: Move connector servers to a dedicated OU so the GPO does not reach other servers.
FindText: make sure all Connector servers are located under the dedicated OU

Title: Connector INF hardening imported (out of domain)
Remediation: Import the connector INF via Local Security Policy, then verify with secedit /analyze.
FindText: Non-Active Directory domain ('Out of Domain') || Out of Domain

Title: GPO hardening updated BEFORE component upgrade; GPO customizations re-applied
Remediation: Process check: confirm against change records.
FindText: ensure that you first update the GPO hardening || customizations

Title: CPM_Hardening.ps1 has run and its log has no errors
Evidence: no hardening log found in /fake/CPM/InstallationAutomation (script likely never run, or logs removed)
Remediation: Run CPM\InstallationAutomation CPM_Hardening.ps1 as Administrator. If PVWA is on the same host, run it after the PVWA hardening.

Title: Hardening re-applied after the last CPM upgrade
Evidence: cannot compare: hardening log or component binaries not found
Remediation: Run CPM_Hardening.ps1 -FromVersion <previous version> after an upgrade.

Title: IsPSMInstalled=True in CPM_Hardening_Config.xml when PSM is on the same server
Remediation: Set IsPSMInstalled=True BEFORE running the CPM hardening, because the INF import, server roles and RDS steps affect PSM.

Title: CPM local service users exist (PasswordManagerUser, ScannerUser)
Evidence: missing: PasswordManagerUser, ScannerUser (may be domain accounts; verify)
Remediation: Enable the PasswordManagerServicesLocalUser step. The latest docs also list PluginManagerUser; v13.0 creates it at install time.

Title: 'Log on as a service' granted to PasswordManagerUser and ScannerUser
Evidence: The property 'Count' cannot be found on this object. Verify that the property exists.
Remediation: Re-run the CPM hardening. Review any other principals that hold the right (PVWA users are legitimate on combined hosts).

Title: DEP disabled for PMTerminal.exe, Telnet.exe, Plink.exe
Evidence: PMTerminal.exe: no DEP opt-out found; Telnet.exe: no DEP opt-out found; Plink.exe: no DEP opt-out found
Remediation: Re-run the CPM hardening step. The probe checks AppCompatFlags\Layers for DisableNXShowUI, which is an inferred mechanism.

Title: Unneeded services disabled (RRAS, SNMP Trap, SAC Helper, WER, WinHTTP Auto-Proxy)
Evidence: Routing and Remote Access: not installed; SNMP Trap: not installed; Special Administration Console Helper: not installed; Windows Error Reporting Service: Manual/Stopped; WinHTTP Web Proxy Auto-Discovery Service: not installed
Remediation: Re-run the hardening step, or set these services to Disabled.
FindText: Special Administration Console Helper || Windows Error Reporting

Title: Smart Card services disabled (listed in v13.0 docs only)
Evidence: Smart Card: not installed; Smart Card Removal Policy: not installed
Remediation: Version-dependent: the latest ISPSS list omits these services. Check your version's page.

Title: SSL 2.0/3.0 and TLS 1.0/1.1 disabled
Evidence: SSL 2.0/Server: Enabled=<unset> DisabledByDefault=<unset>; SSL 2.0/Client: Enabled=<unset> DisabledByDefault=<unset>; SSL 3.0/Server: Enabled=<unset> DisabledByDefault=<unset>; SSL 3.0/Client: Enabled=<unset> DisabledByDefault=<unset>; TLS 1.0/Server: Enabled=<unset> DisabledByDefault=<unset>; TLS 1.0/Client: Enabled=<unset> DisabledByDefault=<unset>; TLS 1.1/Server: Enabled=<unset> DisabledByDefault=<unset>; TLS 1.1/Client: Enabled=<unset> DisabledByDefault=<unset>
Remediation: Re-run the hardening TLS step.
FindText: disables older SSL/TLS versions as they have known vulnerabilities

Title: TLS 1.2 / TLS 1.3 state (latest docs: script enables TLS 1.3; TLSVersions=UseTLS1_2 for 1.2)
Evidence: TLS 1.2/Server: Enabled=; TLS 1.2/Client: Enabled=; TLS 1.3/Server: Enabled=; TLS 1.3/Client: Enabled= (blank = OS default)
Remediation: Confirm that the enabled protocol matches what your Vault/connector version supports.

Title: FIPS cryptography enabled (optional: EnableFIPSCryptography, default No)
Evidence: Step disabled in /fake/CPM/InstallationAutomation/CPM_Hardening_Config.xml: EnableFIPSCryptography=No | HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Lsa\FipsAlgorithmPolicy\Enabled not present
Remediation: Only if required: set EnableFIPSCryptography=Yes in CPM_Hardening_Config.xml before running.

Title: Only minimum server roles/features installed
Evidence: Step disabled in /fake/CPM/InstallationAutomation/CPM_Hardening_Config.xml: ValidateServerRoles=No | installed roles: FileAndStorage-Services
Remediation: Review the installed features in the evidence. Privilege Cloud upgrade guidance sets ValidateServerRoles=No.
FindText: Only the minimum roles and features that are required should be defined on the CPM server || ValidateServerRoles

Title: Advanced audit subcategories configured (Success and Failure)
Evidence: 1 subcategories: 1 Success+Failure, 0 No Auditing. Compare with the doc audit table.
Remediation: Compare against the audit table on the CPM task page. If load is too high, CyberArk allows Failure-only auditing.

Title: Event log size and retention configured
Remediation: Compare the sizes against the values on the CPM task page.

Title: CPM INF security template imported
Remediation: Verify with: secedit /analyze /db %temp%\chk.sdb /cfg <CPM INF> /log %temp%\chk.log
FindText: Imports the INI file containing the hardening settings

Title: CyberArk CPM hardening GPO applied
Evidence: applied computer GPOs: Default Domain Policy; matched: <none>
Remediation: Link the CyberArk CPM hardening GPO to the CPM OU and run gpupdate /force.

Title: Step/switch 'ImportINF' turned off in hardening file
Remediation: Confirm this exclusion is approved and documented.

Title: Step/switch 'IsPSMInstalled' turned off in hardening file
Remediation: Confirm this exclusion is approved and documented.
